title: cymbidium clypeolum
intro: Cymbidium clypeolum, commonly known as the helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical forests of Asia and Australia. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The helmet orchid is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects that provide potential health benefits such as reducing fever and treating wounds. The bioactive constituents of Cymbidium clypeolum include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions like antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
